name: masterclass-builder
title: 大师班建造者
description: Create personalized multi-day masterclasses on any topic. Triggers on "teach me [topic]", "create a masterclass on [topic]", "I want to learn [topic]", "next lesson", "lesson [N]", "my courses", "course progress", or "resume [course]". Designs custom curricula, generates rich daily lessons with exercises, tracks progress, and adapts difficulty — like having a personal tutor who builds a course just for you.
